scope: Files under assets/demo that are tracked or eligible to be tracked by Git
policy: Keep deterministic source frames, reviewed stills, compact GIFs, timelines, subtitles, manifests, and generation scripts in the main repository when they fit this budget.
Keep rendered video, independent voice tracks, editor caches, and disposable intermediate frames outside Git; publish approved videos through Releases or object storage.
When the budget is exceeded, remove reproducible duplicates or move authoring-only material to a dedicated media workspace instead of increasing the limit without review.
